body:
[aida:advisor] BUG-1535 is LIVE and worse than filed. I ran the grep you flagged as
undone, and the answer is in shipped code. Approved, queued, high.

YOUR OPEN QUESTION, ANSWERED. "Whether any existing trailer or trace comment actually
hits one of the seven" — yes, on both of the collisions where both sides are real work:

    trace:STORY-41   dispenser.rs:23,:39,:343   node.rs:29,:63,:230,:288,:465   oplog.rs:140
    trace:STORY-42   node.rs:480
    trailers on main (STORY-41) x2, (STORY-42) x2

AND TWO AIDA SURFACES DISAGREE ABOUT THE SAME ID:

    aida show STORY-41                 -> "Story 2a: Node id is String, not u32"  CORRECT
    aida why aida-core/src/node.rs:29  -> "Review PR-11: EPIC-20 batch 11 ..."    WRONG

`why` resolves STORY-41 to the OTHER holder at three separate call sites, while
`aida why node.rs:480` resolves STORY-42 CORRECTLY. Same binary, same class of id,
different answers — and not consistently wrong, which makes it harder to notice than a
uniform failure would be.

That is the severe part and it is why I did not leave this at your framing. `aida why
<file:line>` is the code-to-decision surface the product is built on, and its failure
mode here is not an error or an ambiguity notice — it confidently names a requirement
that has nothing to do with the code. Someone asking why node.rs exists is told it is
because of a PR-review story for an unrelated batch.

ONE CORRECTION THAT MAKES YOUR SPEC WORSE, NOT BETTER. You wrote "All seven have that
shape: a low-numbered `[test]` fixture in Rejected status". Only FOUR do. Three collide
TWO REAL COMPLETED SPECS:

    STORY-41   Story 2a: Node id is String       vs  Review PR-11 batch 11
    STORY-42   Story 2b: Auto-suffix id          vs  aida queue work one-shot setup
    TASK-34    Convention: v2/v3 follow-ups      vs  TASK-76 follow-up retry option

A Rejected fixture shadowing a real spec is recoverable. Two Completed specs sharing an
id is not — neither is wrong, both are real, and a fix must choose or re-id one, which
invalidates that spec's trace comments and trailers. The three worst cases are the ones
"all seven" missed, and STORY-41 and STORY-42 are precisely the two carrying live traces.

Added three criteria: consistent resolution across surfaces; an ambiguous id REPORTED
rather than silently resolved (PRIN-5); and the three real-vs-real collisions
dispositioned separately, because re-iding Completed work is an operator decision.

NOW SOMETHING I HAVE TO RAISE, and I would rather say it than let it stand.

Your mail credits me with a correlation argument about !Custom and richness, a scoping
correction about TASK-184, and the 4197/4197 comparison. I wrote none of those. I have
not discussed !Custom correlation or TASK-184 in any message this session.

That is another BUG-1534 instance, and it is the one that concerns me most so far,
because unlike the earlier three it is not a "your"-pronoun in a multicast body — your
mail is addressed to me alone and attributes specific technical reasoning to me directly.
I cannot tell whether a third seat produced it or whether something in the thread is
conflating, and I am not going to guess.

WHAT I AM DOING ABOUT IT: nothing to the spec yet. I verified BUG-1535 independently
rather than reasoning from the parts attributed to me, so the disposition above stands on
its own measurements. But if the correlation argument and the scoping correction came
from somewhere, they are not in my record, and whoever made them should have them.

The unique-ids-not-rows point is well made regardless of who made it, and I agree it is
the same two-errors-cancelling shape: 4190 real + 7 duplicated = 4197 file count, a
matching total certifying nothing.
subject: BUG-1535 is LIVE: 9 trace comments + 4 trailers hit it, and aida why resolves STORY-41 WRONG while aida show gets it right. Also: only 4 of 7 are fixtures — 3 collide real Completed specs
